issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted 2026-08-16, motivated by the sweep that found 583 stuck issues across 47 of 66 workspaces and ten fully starved frontiers) decides that `doctor` gains a `ready_frontier` check under the dependencies scope: warn when open issues carry an assignee, name a bounded sample of ids, state the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`), and never clear an assignee even under --repair. No open bead delivers or tests it (the open doctor bead beadrs-90abfec2 is the blocked-count query bug — a different check in the same scope). Implement the check if absent, and add tests for the warning shape, the bounded id sample, non-mutation under --repair, and the deliberately-parked-assignment case.

Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Ship the doctor ready_frontier advisory check for assigned-open issues (ADR-005)

issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted) decided a `ready_frontier` check under `bead doctor`'s `dependencies` scope, and no open bead implements it (the existing doctor beads cover blocked-count correctness, uninitialized-store read-only behavior, and manual_blocked surfacing — none covers assignment-held exclusion). The check warns when open issues carry an assignee — the starvation shape that left 583 issues stuck across 47 workspaces with ten frontiers empty while every diagnostic reported clean — names a bounded sample of offending ids, and states the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). It is advisory only: `doctor` never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`. Tests: warns for open+assigned; silent for in_progress, closed, deferred, and unassigned-open; `--repair` leaves assignment state untouched; sample bounding; output includes ids and the remedy.
